title: 海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場
summary: 以分期示範、近岸基礎與集電解析海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Formosa Offshore Wind Farm through phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場案例中比較苗栗近岸資源與不同機型blade，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate miaoli nearshore resources and different turbine blades within the Formosa Offshore Wind Farm case.

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對苗栗近岸資源提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for miaoli nearshore resources.
steps.instruction: 在「海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識苗栗近岸資源。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分期示範、近岸基礎與集電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify miaoli nearshore resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
steps.observationEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
steps.check: 提交苗栗近岸資源的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for miaoli nearshore resources.

knowledge.title: 風資源與功率包絡
knowledge.text: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 本課架構對應：苗栗近岸資源
knowledge.textEn: Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Course architecture correspondence: Miaoli nearshore resources

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 教學小型風輪假設ρ=1.225 kg/m³、面積110 m²、風速9 m/s、Cp=0.40，P=0.5ρAv³Cp=19.6465 kW。未含傳動電損、尾流、額定限值與風速分佈，不是本工程產品數值。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a teaching rotor with rho=1.225 kg/m³, A=110 m², v=9 m/s and Cp=0.40: P=19.6465 kW. Drivetrain/electrical loss, wakes, ratings and wind distributions are excluded; these are not project specifications.

quiz.question: 就苗栗近岸資源的「風資源與功率包絡」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for wind resources and power envelopes in miaoli nearshore resources?
options: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。
額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output.
Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
quiz.explanationEn: Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對苗栗近岸資源提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for miaoli nearshore resources.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「風資源與功率包絡」模型，檢查苗栗近岸資源的兩個假想案例。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous wind resources and power envelopes model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving miaoli nearshore resources. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
steps.observationEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
steps.check: 提交苗栗近岸資源的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for miaoli nearshore resources.

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對不同機型blade提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for different turbine blades.
steps.instruction: 在「海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識不同機型blade。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分期示範、近岸基礎與集電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify different turbine blades in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。
steps.observationEn: Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.
steps.check: 提交不同機型blade的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for different turbine blades.

steps.title: 傳動與發電轉換：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Drivetrain and electrical conversion: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對分期電力轉換提出可反駁的傳動與發電轉換模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable drivetrain and electrical conversion model and evidence record for phased power conversion.
steps.instruction: 在「海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識分期電力轉換。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分期示範、近岸基礎與集電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify phased power conversion in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：直驅代表無需發電機或功率電子。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Direct drive removes generators and power electronics.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「傳動與發電轉換」模型，檢查分期電力轉換的兩個假想案例。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous drivetrain and electrical conversion model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving phased power conversion. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。

steps.instructionEn: Identify nearshore foundations/sea states in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.observationEn: Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable array wakes and cables model and evidence record for collection/export routing.
steps.instruction: 在「海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識集電與export路由。上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 建立陣列尾流與海纜的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分期示範、近岸基礎與集電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify collection/export routing in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Formosa Offshore Wind Farm. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 監測維護與疲勞：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring, maintenance and fatigue: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對示範至商業證據提出可反駁的監測維護與疲勞模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable monitoring, maintenance and fatigue model and evidence record for demonstration/commercial evidence.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「監測維護與疲勞」模型，檢查示範至商業證據的兩個假想案例。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous monitoring, maintenance and fatigue model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving demonstration/commercial evidence. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。
steps.observationEn: Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：容量因數與可用率是同一比例。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.
steps.check: 提交示範至商業證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for demonstration/commercial evidence.
